title: Coffee at the Diner
notes: Side quest from the Scene Book's Monday quest log: "[Marlene] has news, and the news board introduces how the town talks." Claude's draft.
Runs the first time you walk in while [Marlene] is working (5:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.). It plants Short Shelves.

pour.speaker: [Marlene]
text: [Marlene] pours before you sit down. "You look like a Monday."

She tips her head at the board by the register. Index cards, a church flyer, a truck for sale, somebody's grandson on the honor roll. "Pantry's short this week. Ruth's asking around. I'm just telling you what the board says."
That's how the town talks. Somebody writes it on a card. Everybody reads it by lunch.

choices.label: "What else is on there?"
result: "Lost cat. Bridge on [Route 46] is down to one lane. And Bob's selling the truck again, which means it broke again."

effects.objective: You know how the town talks now: the board.

choices.label: Drink the coffee.
result: It's hot and it's bitter and she refills it before you put it down.

effects.objective: You know how the town talks now: the board.
